notes.title: Full game releasing
notes.content: The game some of you all have played was just the introduction and will be releasing the entire game it will over right your old game for free. The price will increase to $4.99 and of course go on sale for $2.99 twice a year at some point. Thanks to everyone who has supported my solo-man business. After this project only one of my series will be on RPG Maker. Everything else will be made on Unreal Engine 5+. Thanks again everyone for the support the game will Release in NOVEMBER OF 2025 THANK YOU!

notes.content: Just a small patch to update a few issues that were discovered after the month of testing for a game less then an hour long. Fixing the ending, and a few weird glitches you may find or may not find. As well as some grammar like here in this patch update info. Taking a little longer then expected.
